column1: # main imports nothing from subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_DLSS) or subsdk2 (C / libc) that the host does not supply (dm/games/profile_guess.py modules)
# The Switch 2 program's own RomFS holds only dummy.bin (5 bytes); the game files come from the Switch 1 program and the add-on
# The NPDM declares 96 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on, and main never sets a heap.
# nninitStartup reserves a 60 GB address region (returning to main+0x969a64), as Xenoblade Chronicles X's does;
# the Mac's Switch 2 layout supplies the 128 GB alias region, and Switch 2 enforces Horizon's physical-pool limit by default.
# Through the prologue and its first battle the game mapped up to +8.25 GB of it, stopped by the 9 GB pool: 3.4 GB resident.
